acceptanceCriteria: AICockpit can create mapped GitHub Issues for Tasks and Issues with explicit approval.
AICockpit can update allowed GitHub metadata and labels with explicit approval.
GitHub status labels stay synchronized with local workflow status.
AICockpit rejects status-verified for Tasks and Issues, even with approval.
implementationDetails:
Added GitHub issue creation and update operations to the GitHub transport abstraction and CLI transport.
Added controlled GitHub create/update methods that require `--approve --approved-by` before live mutation.
Updated GitHub issue title, body, status labels, priority labels, sprint labels, and epic labels from Airframe records.
Routed AICockpit Task/Issue create, update, and status commands to controlled GitHub backend methods when `--backend github-issues` is selected.
rationale: GitHub-backed projects need controlled creation and update of mapped GitHub Issues with auditability and explicit approval.

workItem.title: Implement controlled GitHub work item mutation support
